project.title: A sequential ecological steering strategy enables high-rate anammox nitrogen removal from real-sewage with enhanced organic capture
project.description: Anaerobic ammonium oxidation (anammox)-based sewage treatment offers a sustainable method for nitrogen removal and organic carbon recovery as bioenergy. However, rapid enrichment and efficient utilization of anammox bacteria (AnAOB) in mainstream municipal wastewater treatment remain challenging. This study introduces a sequential ecological steering strategy in a hybrid biofilm continuous-flow anaerobic/oxic (An/O) reactor, achieving a high nitrogen removal rate with a short hydraulic retention time (HRT) of 3 hours.
